title: Browser console 404 error on initial load due to missing favicon resource
problem: The live homepage emitted a 404 (Not Found) console error upon load because the browser automatically requests /favicon.ico when no explicit favicon relation is declared.
evidence: Playwright console error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
expected: Homepage loads cleanly with 200 OK and 0 browser console errors.
recommendation: Add explicit <link rel="icon" href="/app_icon_1024x1024.png"> in public/index.html to eliminate the 404 error.
